packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Impact/hit feedback library: resource-node harvest, melee and structure impacts, footstep surface variations (player + Echo locomotion)
packs_accepted.notes: 130 OGG originals preserved in Ogg/, 16-bit PCM WAV conversions in Wav/ (UE5 import format). Pack page: CC0.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: UI feedback palette: navigation clicks, confirmations, errors, screen open/close transitions, toggles and scrolls for every player-facing screen
packs_accepted.notes: 100 OGG originals preserved in Ogg/, 16-bit PCM WAV conversions in Wav/ (UE5 import format). Pack page: CC0.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Sci-fi survival feedback: energy-weapon fire, dungeon/building doors, research-station computer noise, force fields, explosions, skiff engine/thruster loops
packs_accepted.notes: 73 OGG originals preserved in Ogg/, 16-bit PCM WAV conversions in Wav/ (UE5 import format). Pack page: CC0.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Biome dressing for the 12-zone world: trees (forest/pine/palm/oak variants), rocks, cliffs, plants, flowers, mushrooms, plus crop-field, fence, campfire, tent, bridge and statue pieces for farms, villages and ruins
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained, embedded buffers). ground_grass/ground_river tiles dropped — terrain and water are procedural in ASTRAWILD. FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL/MTL format duplicates and 2D preview sprites dropped at selection time.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Sci-fi ruins/dungeon dressing: corridors, structures, platforms, pipes, gates, hangars, machines, satellite dishes, craters and crystal rocks for Hollow Underlight, Sunken Vault, Eye of the Maelstrom and ancient-tech landmarks; turret pieces for Bolt Turret visuals
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained). Character/vehicle/monorail/rocket models excluded: NPC skins are deferred cosmetic scope, the skiff already exists, no rail/rocket consuming system. FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL/MTL duplicates and 2D preview sprites dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Energy weapon model library: 40 blaster variants as candidate held-weapon meshes (CANDIDATE_REPLACEMENT pool for the 5 procedural weapon meshes; binding decided at UE integration)
packs_accepted.notes: GLB + shared Textures/colormap.png dependency (URIs resolve relative to the GLB folder). FBX/OBJ duplicates and preview images dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Combat VFX sprite library: muzzle flashes, impact sparks, smoke puffs, glows and particle textures feeding upgraded Niagara systems (CombatComponent FX pool + AstrawildVfxActor fallback art)
packs_accepted.notes: Transparent-background PNG sprites only (the PNG (Black background) folder is a baked-black-bg duplicate set for tools without alpha support — redundant in UE where Niagara sprites use the alpha channel directly). Preview.png and XML metadata skipped. UE usage: Niagara sprite/flipbook textures (base + pre-rotated frames).

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Sci-fi UI art: panels, buttons, sliders and icons for the 7 C++ UMG widget classes (HUD, inventory, research, shop, dialogue, pause)
packs_accepted.notes: PNG art preserving style/state subfolders (Blue/Green/Grey/Red/Yellow/Extra x Default/Double — state variants reuse base filenames, so the sub-path is part of the asset identity); Kenney Future/Narrow TTF fonts kept for UMG; SVG vector sources skipped. Publisher download file is kenney_ui-pack-space-expansion.zip (Space Expansion naming).

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Survival-frontier props: camps, fires, crates, tools and shelters across all 12 zones; POI dressing and village outskirts (Dawn Fields, Verdant Reach)
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained, v2.0 with animations as claimed on page). FBX/OBJ format duplicates and preview images dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Industrial/research props: containers, cranes, pipes and warehouse shells for Ember Ridge, Stormcrest, research POIs and the Dawnstead industrial quarter
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained, v2.0 with variations). FBX/OBJ format duplicates and preview images dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Modular snapping sci-fi interior tiles for the 3 dungeons and Hollow Approach ruined-ancient-tech layouts (distinct from the classic Space Kit dressing pack)
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained, v1.0 with variations/animations as claimed on page). FBX/OBJ format duplicates and preview images dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Stone/ancient modular dungeon tiles for the 3 dungeons' ruin segments and Sunscar ruins
packs_accepted.notes: GLB only (self-contained, v1.0 with variations/animations as claimed on page). FBX/OBJ format duplicates and preview images dropped.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: NPC/villager body candidate (12 NPCs, 2 villages) + locomotion animation reference (idle/run/jump); rig-retarget compatibility to be checked in engine
packs_accepted.notes: Classic Kenney character pack: ONE medium-detail humanoid FBX (Model/characterMedium.fbx) + 3 FBX animations; 2D skin sprites and SVG sources skipped. Research correction: this is NOT a GLB multi-rigged-character pack (inference was wrong — corrected at acquisition against the actual zip). Value = retarget reference + NPC body candidate.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Alien sky dome art for 12-zone atmosphere variants (day/dusk/night/storm/space equirectangular textures)
packs_accepted.notes: PNG equirectangular sky textures (Skyboxes/skybox-*.png — day/morning/night/alien/space); Sample renders and Preview.png skipped. Import as long-lat in engine.

packs_accepted.creator: Kenney
packs_accepted.usage: Reticle art replacing the text-glyph crosshair in HudWidget (hip-fire/aim states already coded)
packs_accepted.notes: PNG reticles (64x64) preserving style subfolders (Dark/Glow/Light/Outline — families reuse base filenames, so the sub-path is part of the identity). Tilesheet atlases skipped (duplicates of the individual PNGs); Preview.png and SVG variants skipped.

packs_rejected.name: Sci-Fi RTS
packs_rejected.reason: 2D top-down sprite pack (259 PNGs, spritesheets, SVG/SWF) — not 3D models. ASTRAWILD is a 3D third-person game with no top-down sprite consuming system.

packs_rejected.name: Digital Audio
packs_rejected.reason: Retro 8-bit aesthetic — does not fit the sci-fi survival frontier audio identity.

packs_rejected.name: UI Audio
packs_rejected.reason: Duplicate role — superseded by Interface Sounds (newer, larger pack covering the same UI feedback category); accepting both would create near-duplicate libraries.

packs_rejected.name: RPG Audio
packs_rejected.reason: Fantasy-specific sounds (coins, potions, spells) — weak fit for sci-fi survival; no consuming system.

packs_rejected.name: Kenney 2D creature/character packs (Monster Builder, Animal Pack, Animal Pack Remastered, Alien UFO, Robot, Fish, Toon Characters, Shape Characters)
packs_rejected.reason: All 2D sprite packs — ASTRAWILD needs 3D meshes for creatures/NPCs; the hoped-for 3D creature catalog does not exist at Kenney (verified during the batch-2 gap analysis, full catalog walk).

packs_rejected.name: Quaternius newer packs (Sci-Fi Essentials Kit, MegaKits, Universal Animation Library 2)
packs_rejected.reason: Custom QAL v1.0 license — free commercial use but redistribution prohibited, which forbids committing the assets into this repository; only Quaternius 'Ultimate'-series pages explicitly stating CC0 are eligible.

other_sources_evaluated.reason: Researched during batch-2 planning: per-asset licenses are machine-parseable (CC0-filterable, 2,807 CC0 3D assets) and anonymous direct downloads verified — viable as a future batch once the downloader gains a per-asset license gate and a curated allowlist; not needed for this batch (Kenney covered the gaps).
Official publisher downloads from kenney.nl are preferred and were available for every approved pack; no GitHub mirror required.

Ultimate Animated Animal Pack page states CC0 (creature-mesh candidate), but delivery is a Google Drive folder rather than a direct download URL — needs a manual fetch plus validator pass, or a Drive-aware pipeline extension, and per-pack CC0 re-verification at download time; newer Quaternius packs use QAL (redistribution prohibited) and are excluded.
Site-wide CC0 verified on their license pages; realistic-style HDRIs/PBR textures are a P2 upgrade path, not a current gap — deliberately not acquired (FEWER + BETTER).
itch.io downloads are click-through pages, not plain direct URLs; per-pack license pages not yet verified.
